title: Visibility

inlines.v: VISIBIL'ITY, noun s as z. 1. The state or quality of being perceivable to the eye; as the visibility of minute particles, or of distant objects. 2. The state of being discoverable or apparent; conspicuousness; as the perpetual visibility of the church.
